summary: Iteration 5 validates 2 new features end-to-end: (A) GET /api/artists/{id}/availability?date=YYYY-MM-DD returning booked slots (excluding cancelled), and (B) frontend BOOKED slot rendering + Cancellation Policy screen linked from booking step 3. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_5_availability.py — 5/5 PASSED. (1) unknown artist → 404. (2) future date w/no bookings → booked_slots=[]. (3) shape {artist_id,date,booked_slots:list}. (4) create booking @12:00 on far-future date → slot appears in booked_slots; then cancel booking → slot is EXCLUDED (verified status filter). (5) Seeded Kai Nakamura tomorrow-16:00 IS present in booked_slots. Regression: backend_test.py (16) + test_iteration_4_refund_and_map.py (9) all 25/25 pass; combined new + regression 32/32. FRONTEND (390x844, demo user @ Kai Nakamura /book flow): tomorrow date chip renders and on tap fires the availability fetch; time-16:00 chip is aria-disabled=true with visible 'BOOKED' label and strike-through text (verified DOM content '16:00\nBOOKED'). Tapping the disabled 16:00 chip does NOT set time (Pressable disabled + guard on onPress). Step 3 renders SECURED-BY-STRIPE row with the red 'POLICY →' link (testID=view-cancellation-policy) which navigates to /cancellation-policy. Cancellation Policy screen renders header 'DEPOSIT — $50 / CANCELLATION POLICY', shield intro card, and all three tiers with correct color-coded borders (success green for 48H+, warning yellow for 24-48H, error red for <24H+no-show), plus the HOW TO CANCEL foot note and legal fine print. Back arrow (testID=policy-back) returns to booking Step 3 (confirm button visible). Cannot exercise 'date change clears newly-booked time' cleanly in web preview without creating a fresh conflicting booking, but the useEffect logic in book/[artistId].tsx L74-76 (if time && bookedSlots.includes(time) → setTime('')) is straightforward and correct.
action_items: Optional UX: on the booking flow Step 1, when a previously selected time gets auto-cleared because it was newly booked, surface a small inline toast/hint like 'YOUR 16:00 SLOT WAS JUST BOOKED — PICK ANOTHER' so the user understands why the time field went blank. Current behavior silently clears via useEffect.

Optional code hygiene: availability endpoint does not validate the date format (accepts any string). Consider adding a Pydantic query model or regex validation (^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$) to fail-fast on malformed input; currently a bogus date just returns booked_slots=[].
Optional accessibility: cancellation-policy.tsx policy-back Pressable has no accessibilityLabel (add 'Back to booking').
Stripe key still 'sk_test_emergent' placeholder — mock flow remains active; main agent should swap when real key is provisioned.
critical_code_review_comments: book/[artistId].tsx L56-71: availability fetch is not debounced. Rapid date-chip tapping fires many overlapping requests; the `cancelled` flag prevents stale state writes so it is functionally correct, but consider a 150ms debounce for network hygiene.

book/[artistId].tsx L74-76: reset-time-if-booked runs on every bookedSlots change; if the user has 16:00 selected and switches to a date where 16:00 is also booked, the time silently clears — good behavior but consider inline feedback (see action item 1).
server.py L345-355: availability endpoint has no auth requirement. That is fine for a discovery-style API, but note that a scraper could enumerate an artist's schedule. Not blocking.
server.py L355: returns `sorted({d['time_slot'] for d in docs})` — set→sorted list dedupes correctly. Good.

cancellation-policy.tsx: uses Stack.Screen options={{ headerShown:false }} inside the screen body — works with expo-router but relying on Stack import at render time; verified it renders on web preview. No issue.
cancellation-policy.tsx L48: string literal contains a curly apostrophe rendered via `{"'"}` — good, avoids JSX quote clash.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for both new features (BOOKED chip + policy screen)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_ far-future (365d out) booking on artist[0] @12:00 created then cancelled to prove exclusion. Reused prior demo-user tomorrow-16:00 Kai booking to verify BOOKED rendering.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Availability endpoint: GET /api/artists/{id}/availability?date=YYYY-MM-DD (unauthenticated). Returns {artist_id, date, booked_slots:[]}. Excludes bookings with status=='cancelled'. New testIDs: view-cancellation-policy (step 3 booking screen), cancellation-policy-screen (root), policy-back (back arrow). Time chip testIDs are time-HH:MM; booked chips are aria-disabled=true and include 'BOOKED' text with line-through styling on the time text. Demo user has a seeded tomorrow-16:00 booking with Kai Nakamura — DO NOT DELETE. Stripe still 'sk_test_emergent' placeholder.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All new features working end-to-end.
